Roof Plumbing & Re-Roofing in Balnarring Beach

Sandhurst Roofing is a family owned roofing business with more than 30 years of experience looking after homes right across Balnarring Beach. From re-roofs in COLORBOND® steel and roof plumbing to guttering and tile to tin conversions, we back every job with honest advice and quality workmanship.

Balnarring Beach sits close to the water, so we know what salt air and wind do to metal roofs, flashings and gutters, and we recommend materials that stand up to it. Call Steve on 0448 812 800 for a free, no-obligation quote.

Get a Free Quote!

Roofs in Balnarring Beach: What We Commonly See

Balnarring Beach is a quiet foreshore pocket on Western Port, a strip of beach houses and holiday homes set close to the sand and the foreshore reserve. That close-to-the-water position means salt-laden air works on roofs all year, corroding metal sheets, ridge capping fixings, valleys and gutters faster than inland. Many homes here are weekenders and older beach houses whose roofs have not been maintained every season.

The issues we see most at Balnarring Beach are rusted gutters and valleys, lifted ridge capping, blocked gutters under the tea-tree and coastal scrub, and leaks from corroded flashings.

Re-Roofing & Roof Replacement in Balnarring Beach

When a roof has reached the end of its life, replacing it is the smarter long-term spend. We re-roof Balnarring Beach homes in COLORBOND® steel, which is light, strong and well suited to bayside weather, and we use quality fixings, flashings and gutters that stand up to salt air.

If you are thinking about going metal, our tile to tin service is a popular way to lose the weight and the upkeep. If you are unsure whether you need a full re-roof, we will inspect the roof, show you what we find and give you an honest recommendation.

Roof Plumbing & Guttering in Balnarring Beach

Our registered roof plumbers look after the parts of the roof that take the most punishment near the water: flashings, valleys, ridge capping, box gutters and downpipes. Salt air eats through poorly finished metal quickly, so we trace leaks back to the real source and fix them properly rather than patching the ceiling stain.

Whether you need one section of guttering replaced or a full re-gutter with matching downpipes in COLORBOND® steel, we will quote it clearly and finish it neatly. Small jobs such as gutter repairs are no problem either.

What Affects the Cost of Roofing in Balnarring Beach

There is no standard price for a roof, because no two roofs are the same. The size and pitch of the roof, the profile and colour of the steel, the amount of guttering, flashings and downpipes, and the access to the site all affect the quote. We inspect the roof, put the price in writing and explain every line.

Our Balnarring Beach Roofing Process

It starts with a free on-site inspection and a written quote. Once you approve it we strip the existing roof, check and prepare the framing, then install new COLORBOND® steel sheeting, flashings and ridge capping, along with new guttering and downpipes where they are part of the job. Every job finishes with a clean site.

Why Balnarring Beach Locals Choose Sandhurst Roofing

Balnarring Beach locals choose Sandhurst Roofing because we turn up when we say we will, do quality work and charge a fair price. We are fully licensed and insured, with registered roof plumbers on the team, and we explain what is happening every step of the way. Have a look at the COLORBOND® colour chart to start choosing your colour.

Balnarring Beach Roofing FAQs

Does living near the bay affect my roof?

Yes. Salt air corrodes metal roofs, fixings, flashings and gutters faster than it does inland, so coastal homes benefit from quality COLORBOND® materials and regular checks.

How long does a re-roof take?

Most homes are completed in a few days, weather depending. We will give you a realistic timeframe with your quote.

Do you offer free quotes?

Yes, every quote is free and without obligation. Call Steve on 0448 812 800.
